scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof establishes all-parameter correctness; finite executable checks only corroborate and do not certify infinity or priority.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem restricted to two routes of lengths at least two, a one-edge shortcut, and route-homogeneous positive conductance prices. Independent audit unperformed; possible specialized literature not exhaustively excluded.
title: A sharp shortcut-deletion frontier for determinant-optimal two-route networks
